notes: Subjects chosen for 2-5 year olds: everyday animals, plants, food, vehicles, weather, toys, space, music and clothes. No people, faces, flags, brands, weapons, alcohol, religious symbols or frightening subjects. Pages marked free:true are the fixed free subset (8 per category, spread over the levels; mostly level 1 in space, music and clothes); once free, a page stays free. A page id is <category>_<code> and saved artworks keep it, so a page that has shipped never changes category. A page with "skip" is not built; the value says why.
